cons.name: ih
cons.type:
∀ (inventory : Inventory) (beforeCaller : Caller width) (before : EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint) (memos : Memos), Context formulas solver inventory beforeCaller memos → StorageValid before.core → PendingRealized beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap before.core → Roots before.core.representatives roots → EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct roots before.core.values before.waiting → (∀ (slot : Nat), SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.candidate beforeCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ((before.core.values[slot]?).getD .eliminated) = some (before.expandable slot)) → PendingAt before.core target → (∀ source ∈ rest, PendingOrEliminated before.core source) → SourcePruningEnumerationFold.Ranges checkEmpty rest beforeCaller before.core target memos.query → ∃ (fuel p h : Nat)
      (rows : List (Unit × EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint))
      (afterCaller : Caller width) (savedQueries : Queries) (final : Memos) (next : Inventory)
      (after : EnumerationExpandableIndex.Cached Symbol Constraint),
      (∀ extra P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H →
        SourcePruningEnumerationCachedFold.run checkEmpty (fuel + extra) P H rest
          beforeCaller before target memos.query =
          ((.ok (some (rows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))),
            afterCaller, savedQueries, after.core), some after)) ∧
      Post formulas solver next beforeCaller afterCaller final ∧ final.query = savedQueries ∧
      after.core.counter = before.core.counter ∧
      after.core.representatives = before.core.representatives ∧ Roots after.core.representatives roots ∧
      StorageValid after.core ∧ PendingRealized afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap after.core ∧
      EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct roots after.core.values after.waiting ∧
      after.waiting = before.waiting ∧
      (∀ (slot : Nat), SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.candidate
        afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap
        ((after.core.values[slot]?).getD .eliminated) = some (after.expandable slot)) ∧
      (rows = [] ∨ rows = [((), after)]) ∧ PendingAt after.core target ∧
      (∀ (slot : Nat), before.core.values[slot]? = some .eliminated →
        after.core.values[slot]? = some .eliminated) ∧
      (rows = [((), after)] → ∀ source ∈ rest, source ≠ target →
        after.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated)
